title: ShoppingListDetailView: core structure
description: Add `CookbookApp/ShoppingLists/ShoppingListDetailView.swift` with the core detail view: navigation title set to the list display name, a "X of Y items checked" progress header (`.subheadline`, `.secondary`, hidden when list is empty), aisle-grouped sections produced by `ShoppingListAisleGrouper` each rendered with an `AisleIconMap`-derived SF Symbol, the aisle name ("Other" for nil-named bucket), a badge count, and a collapsible disclosure (in-memory per-section collapse state, not persisted across launches). Each item in a section is rendered with `ShoppingListItemRow`. Empty-list empty state: `cart` icon, "Empty list", "Tap + to add an item.".
acceptance_criteria: Navigation title equals the list's display name
"X of Y items checked" header is visible and recomputes after each toggle
Header is hidden when the list has zero items
Sections are in the order returned by ShoppingListAisleGrouper
Each section header shows the correct AisleIconMap SF Symbol, aisle name, and item count badge
Sections are collapsible; collapse state persists across re-renders of the same view instance but not across app launches
Empty-list empty state renders correctly (cart icon, correct title and subtitle)
